title: Several companion personal-grief quests (Osk's Drowned Family/Fenmarch, Tamsin's mine/Cinderhall, Vell's ledger/Hollowbrook) are explicitly and permanently foreclosed the moment you cross the Pass Gate ('A companion's grief left unfinished there stays unfinished'), which is clearly telegraphed, but nothing earlier in the Vale or Thornwold hints that choosing a single hold (per the west-or-east framing) forecloses the other two companions' arcs entirely rather than just delaying them.
